Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 12 Oct 2000, cantila wrote:

> If I play Illusions of the Kindred and it diablerizes a vamp through
> Amaranth and play a Ritual of the Bitter Rose, does the acting vamp
> gain blood as well?

No, because the acting vampire has nothing to do with anything. Your IotK
vamp would gain blood.
